description: Defines the AudioShelvingFilter class, a shelving audio filter with controllable cutoff frequency and gain, utilizing biquad filtering and coefficient interpolation. Includes methods for configuration, parameter setting, processing audio buffers, and enabling/disabling the filter.

classes.name: AudioShelvingFilter
classes.description: A class implementing a shelving audio filter with adjustable cutoff frequency and gain, using biquad filtering and coefficient interpolation.

methods.name: AudioShelvingFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with specified type, channels, and sample rate.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Reconfigures the filter with new channel count and sample rate without changing parameters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets filter parameters to default (frequency=0, gain=0) and disables the filter.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears delay lines without changing parameters.

methods.name: setGain
methods.description: Sets the gain in millibel; actual change occurs upon commit.

methods.name: getGain
methods.description: Returns the current gain in millibel.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the cutoff frequency in millihertz; actual change occurs upon commit.

methods.name: getFrequency
methods.description: Returns the current cutoff frequency in millihertz.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Applies all parameter changes; can be immediate or gradual.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes input audio buffer into output buffer using biquad filter.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the filter to start processing input.
